review_notes: Source-first scope: the selected family is the final growth-conditioned all-deals nonlinear pricing system in Equation (7), Table 7 Panel A, with two dependent-variable equations jointly estimated. The earlier unconditional Equation (5)/Table 6 system is an intermediate form within the same pricing question; the paper says forecast-growth conditioning captures more predictable forecast-error variation. Table 4 affiliation regressions and Table 5 fee regressions are not required constructions for this system; the authors explicitly omit fee basis from the stock-price tests. Affiliation-specific reruns and the parallel OLS illustration are excluded.

The actual realized-earnings-growth least-squares line is included as a supporting regression because its fitted growth measure is required to construct FE. The paper gives conflicting six-year start years (p. 14 versus the Table 7 note on p. 26); the line’s exact time coding, slope-to-growth conversion, usable per-fit N, and log base are not specified.

The method is nonlinear weighted least squares; the paper does not identify the observation weighting scheme or matrix. The α0* and α1* terms in the abnormal-return equation are jointly estimated parameters, not observed RHS variables.
